posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Your lockpicking game turns on self switch A. On page 2, you turn on self switch A again for no reason. If your variable is 1 you then turn self switch A off again for no reason.
Page 2 and 3 both have self switch A as condition, meaning page 2 will never be active. RPG maker will always run the highest page of the event which has its conditions met, meaning solving your minigame will jump straight to page 3.
No idea what plugin "absZ" or lockpicking is. You should always link the plugins you're trying to get help with. There are thousands, and we can't all possibly know them just by you saying "I got the lockpicking plugin" like there is only one that exists.
